query: (sum by (namespace, pod, container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total[7d])) > 0.5) and on (namespace, pod, container) (max_over_time(kube_pod_container_status_last_terminated_reason{reason="OOMKilled"}[7d]) == 1)
why: Every container that ended with OOMKilled at any time in 7 days and restarted in the window, including pods a rollout has since replaced, with the 7-day restart increase of that pod; a pod whose last OOM is older than the window keeps the reason label but has no restart in it and is left out. resources.oomkilled-repeated counts a workload's OOM history from this, not from the pods alive at collection time
